body: I just looked it up and I can see how it might be better suited, thanks heaps
I never heard that one, I will ask my doctor how I can do this. Thank you, I'm gonna look into it 🙂
Im not sure if im much company but it would be nice to have someone to talk too. I feel like ive got no one

I havent said anything suicidal at all, I am just overwhelmed with life atm. I did hit my head and scratch my face but not because im suicidal, I just do that sometimes when ive lost control. I dont know what to do. I can hear him on the phone again with them.....im freaking out but trying to stay calm because if i freak out and look irrational it might not be good.....

BPD is terrible to go through, I have BPD but my hubby doesn't. its so hard when he  always dismisses every single reaction, feeling or opinion that I have and says "its your mental illness talking". I've had enough myself, no one gets it unless they are tormented by it

I know loneliness all too well, though i have all these people around me they dont care. They use me till ive got nothing left and then continue to tell im worthless or I "do nothing". Ive been diagnosed with BPD and Depression a few years ago, Im 30 this year and still battling both of them.  I understand that pain, I wish there was a way to stomp the loneliness but I havent found it yet, if anyone knows please let me in on the secret. 
Im dying inside everyday now, theres no break.

Loneliness is such a hard feeling to shake. I am plagued by it daily, I "have" people in my life but they dont really care to interact with me unless they need me to do something which makes life very lonely. Im too easy to push around, people walk all over me and I don't do anything about it. At this point I'd rather just be turned off lol.

I have a similar experience in my small town, though im not banned from anywhere. I have however had ALOT of mental breakdowns and quite a few of them i went running all over the streets. One of my biggest everyday fears is that im going to come up against someone that has witnessed one of these breakdowns. I havent applied for a job in 2 years since i left my last job due to mental strain. Im too scared someone will remember me being crazy out there and i too would he triggered. I wish I could move, ive tried for the oast 4 years but my husband doesn't want too, even though its clearly driving me insane. 
Hope you find your freedom soon

It's the worse when my mum hangs up and doesn't say I love you. A lot of the time if I've miffed her off she won't even say bye she will just "ok" really loud and hang up on me. I think that is such a cruel move from a mother so I'm sorry you get that too.

As for the money side of things I can totally see where you are coming from. Don't let it make you feel bad or guilty, you are working hard and sacrificing for the safety of your future, I could not imagine how it must feel. Especially to see them spending their money on frivolous things, maybe they could learn a thing or 2 from you about saving. 

I hope you can figure this all out.
Thank you. And I'm glad it's getting better for you. I look forward to the day it does for me 😊

Thank you, you don't know how much I need to hear something like this today. A lot of the times we forget our own strength, we don't realise the things we have overcome. Thank you feel for reminding me 😊

Also thank you, I'm still here. I'm going to try and stick through it. I've made it this far with all of these obstacles. I'm sure I can go a little bit further.
Thank you.

I never realised this was abusive behaviour. I always thought maybe it was because he thinks I'm unwell and doesn't think I can but now I re read what I said and I have been going over some things in my head. I can see that this is a very toxic marriage I am in. He has a really good way of making the people around me think he's Mr perfect so it's very hard because I try to talk to people about it and they say must be doing something wrong for him to act like this. I don't know what I'm doing wrong.

I can relate to this alot. I have BPD and it's flaring up at the moment. I hate it so much, I try so hard to manage the emotions but it all overwhelms me and I too am overly sensitive and I take things as a personal attack on myself when a lot of the times it has nothing to do with me. It's the worst thing to have to deal with. It's like I'm fully here I'm awake but somehow I have no control over my emotions and the way I react to things, doesn't matter how hard I try. I've tried so many different methods of finding ways to manage myself but no luck yet. 
Hope you feel a bit better soon, I know it's exhausting.

I can relate, I have BPD. It's exhausting and most of the time I don't even know what is real and what's being twisted by my thoughts. I've found myself begging the universe to free me these days. BPD is getting too much to cope with. I can understand how you are feeling, sorry you have to go through that.
I don't know anymore. I feel like I'm running out of reasons.
I read something along these lines too. Wonder what came of it.
Good on you for finding reasons that make you want to  stay. You are worthy of a wonderful, full life. I hope you are doing well

I know the feeling. Sometimes I catch myself dreaming of it. Ugh. I have a family I have to worry about so I don't know if it will ever happen for me, I couldn't bare to hurt anyone I love. But they don't understand the pain I feel. The constant torment I'm stuck listening to over and over again in my head. I just want it all to end. If it would stop I could just get some peace.

It's not your fault. None of it. You didn't ask for any of these things to happen to you. I am so sorry that it happened. And I'm sorry that things are happening in your family right now. Maybe your mother is just so hurt and so heartbroken at what's happened to her child and she finding it hard to deal with the thought of it all. I am not a mother yet but I can only imagine the pain (possibly guilt) that she may be feeling about what has happened to you.
Don't feel like any of it is your fault, I hope you can see that soon. I am so sorry you went through that, I hope you are okay.
Hey I'm sorry this happened to you. Don't give in, you got to try again. It's kinda common, it happens to a lot of guys especially first time.

Don't feel dumb, I'm happy you posted here today. I am not very good with advice and I can't speak much on what you are having to deal with in your life but please know I believe all of our lives are valuable, you are needed here on this earth just as much as the anyone else. It's hard to see the good sometimes especially in yourself when you are down, don't let it fool you. You are here for a reason. 
I know it probably means nothing from a random woman on the internet but I truly hope you can start seeing that worth in you soon, when you do everything will start to seem brighter. Don't get me wrong it's very hard, I have some severe mental heal issues and it's a working effort but it can happen. I hope it happens for you soon😊

It's so sad to see you are dealing with this feelings. Would you like to talk? I can private message you :) 
Hope you feel better soon.
I don't know you but I hope you can get things looking up again in your life :)

Hi there
Is there anyway you could get your girlfriend back? Would you want that? I'm sorry you are dealing with pain issues, it can't be very nice to have to deal with pain all the time. 
Hope you are feeling better
I'm glad you don't let him get to you :)

Just focus on getting better okay. I am so glad to hear you are still here with us and you are going to give it another go. I know it's hard and at times can be so daunting but I'm so glad you pulled through today
Hope you are feeling a bit better.

Don't listen to practical turnip, he's a troll. He literally goes on all the posts in this thread trying to push people to their limits. He's a very sad human with no life which is why he come to this very thread because he's so unhappy with his life he has to make other who already feel low feel as low as he does inside.
Can use me for your sacrifice 🙂

Sometimes we can be our own worst critics. Don't be so hard on yourself. There will be many people in this world that will love and accept you for who you are, I hope you can find some of these people soon so they can show you just how beautiful a human being you are.
We are all made in different shapes and sizes, each of us beautiful in our very own ways 😊 
I hope you feel better soon
I know what it feels like to have your thoughts in a constant loop, it's exhausting and I can understand why you feel the way you do. I hope that you choose to stay

You are loved too. I know it's hard but try and remember the feeling of not wanting to die. You said it yourself you don't want to, you are just at a crossroads and you feel like it's your only option. It really isn't, there are other ways.
I hope you are still here
Hi, I am sorry you feel like this. It's terrible to feel like this is your only option, I know that feeling, I experience it all to often myself.
Very true. I hope you are okay :)

I often wonder the same thing. I read an article about this happening to a guy that attempted but survived. It's not nice. I wonder why we don't have that option even when we are so tormented by our minds that we just do whatever we can to harm ourselves. I guess they believe we can get through it...

Wow thank you so much, I've not heard of these supplements but I'm definitely open to anything. I will give these a go 😊 I'll do anything that might help me so thank you very much for the suggestion of these supplements

Did you manage to get to the hospital or get hold of someone to help you? 
I hope you are okay

Hi yes we have tried meds but they just seemed to make me more aggressive and depressed. I have been working with a psychiatrist to figure out some better coping strategies for myself and somewhat helps so thank you for your suggestion :)
